items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: She brought her son in, Ollie... And the son finally come, and we kept him too, Ollie.

ctx.x: I can advise and suggest, be a father to them in my little way, but I've got too many other things to do than to try to raise somebody else's kids. And God knows I tried to do the best I could. She stayed with us and everything so I could get to see her get -- stayed in Jersey with us, trying to save her money. We got her kids, she brought her son in, Ollie, and we had both of her kids and her too at the house. So how far can you go?
Well, you couldn't do more than that.
